title: whatsapp_inbox._quota.set
description: Mirror of `schemas/quota_set.json` in ERPlora/whatsapp_inbox as PUBLISHED today — the module version the fleet is actually running. `additionalProperties: false` is the point of this fixture: it is what makes a hub that sends a field this module has not declared yet lose the cap as well.

monthly_limit.description: Billable messages per calendar month the plan allows. 0 = no cap.
